edition.notes: Catalog-level record created 2026-07-24. Whiston's 1737 translation is public domain and is the text most widely retranscribed online (including the University of Chicago Penelope transcription). Its book-and-chapter divisions differ from the modern Niese section numbering; consumers state which numbering their loci use. No exact artifact has been registered; publications consulting web transcriptions record their own access routes and limits locally.
edition.publication: In The Genuine Works of Flavius Josephus, translated by William Whiston (London, 1737; many later reprints)
edition.title: The Antiquities of the Jews (Whiston translation)

work.author: Flavius Josephus
work.description: Josephus's twenty-book history of the Jewish people, completed c. 93/94 CE. Book 12 retells the Letter of Aristeas's account of the Greek translation of the Law under Ptolemy II. Loci use book with Whiston chapter or chapter.section numbering; consumers state which numbering they follow.
work.title: Antiquitates Judaicae
